title: Networking in Android
learning_outcomes: Explain the central rule or purpose of networking in android using at least one correct term from the lesson.
Interpret or adapt a small Kotlin example that demonstrates networking in android.
Identify one relevant edge case, debugging step, or version/platform constraint.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Networking in Android** as part of **Kotlin for Android Development**. Android application code must respect lifecycle, UI-thread rules, accessibility, permission boundaries, and the compatibility of Android/Compose dependencies. Use the subtopics—API Requests, Serialization and Data Models, Loading, Success, and Error States—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Android code must account for lifecycle changes, accessibility, UI state, and platform APIs. Isolating business logic makes the interface easier to test.
